description: detaxizer, with --generate-downstream-samplesheets, writes downstream_samplesheets/mag-pe.csv for its filtered paired-end reads, in the column layout of mag 3.x; each sample gets its own group and the read platforms mag 5 requires (short reads ILLUMINA, long reads OXFORD_NANOPORE, as detaxizer labels them for taxprofiler). Different samples are not pooled for binning or assembly; use an inline handoff to supply study-specific pooling groups.
